notes: Modified cash basis city (cash). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column of the receipts/disbursements statement (p4); net interfund transfer in 71,229 printed as one net figure (General +142,823, Street -25,657, Other -45,937) is recorded in transfers_in. Beginning 3,151,457 + receipts 2,232,434 (printed total) - disbursements 3,041,771 + transfers 71,229 = ending 2,413,349 ties using the printed total; line items sum 10,000 higher because of the printed grants-and-donations typo. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Net Position (p6) total column (Light, Water, Sewer, Recycle); operating lines are all utilities; interfund transfers (71,229) out in transfers_net. Business-type net position basis is accrual (p5-6) while the government-wide statements (p1-2) show cash-basis net position 2,773,359; the 'business' difference entry records this. Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position (p1) total column (cash basis; no liabilities). Detail: the Budgetary Comparison Schedule (p9) is the only supplementary schedule; it covers all funds by function (actuals only, budget printed for totals only: receipts 4,846,819, disbursements 8,270,999). Lines that mix governmental and business-type activity (Streets and Public Works receipts and disbursements, Other receipts) are split using the Statement of Activities (p2) with split_from/computed. Cash flow statement (p7-8, including the reconciliation of operating income and the cash breakdown: cash 2,505,699 + cash at county 4,415 + restricted 263,245 = 2,773,359) shown but proprietary field is null (cash basis report). Business-type net position on p1/p2 (cash basis, beginning 2,527,496, ending 2,773,359) differs from the accrual proprietary statements p5-6 (beginning 4,408,459, ending 4,816,721; includes capital assets, receivables, inventory and liabilities): a basis difference, not a report error; p6 used for the roll-forward. Read pages 1-9 of 9. Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p4, p6) replace the combined schedule.
